title: Public repository hygiene
description: Keep world-readable repositories free of internal detail and legally clean.

rules.title: No internal detail
rules.text: Treat PRs, issues and comments as world-readable. Keep out internal metrics, vendor or pricing talk and customer details.

rules.title: Relative numbers
rules.text: State percentages, ratios or relative change instead of absolute production numbers.

rules.title: Report privately
rules.text: Report vulnerabilities through the project security policy, never in a public issue or PR.

rules.title: License headers
rules.text: Keep the required license header on every new source file.

rules.title: DCO sign-off
rules.text: Add a Signed-off-by line when the project requires a Developer Certificate of Origin. The human author signs.

rules.title: License compatibility
rules.text: Only add code and dependencies whose licenses are compatible with the project license.

rules.title: No competitor names
rules.text: Do not name competitors in code, comments or docs unless a protocol or format requires it.

rules.title: No private links
rules.text: Do not link to private trackers, chats or documents from public code.
